name: battle-for-the-dawn
description: Web mecha co-op game with Phaser, TypeScript and persistent pilot profiles

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck && npm run build:client
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-concurrency=2 web/tests/*.test.cjs packages/simulation/tests/*.test.cjs server/*.test.cjs client/tests/*.test.cjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && node --check server/server.cjs && node --check server/profiles.cjs
